label: D1: reward just received in state S1 (strongest after rare a2->S1 reward), while policy not yet strongly a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (in_rew==1 covers 100% of activations). It essentially never fires when the rewarded state was S2: (D1 & in_rew==1 & prev_state!=2) has recall 0.97 and mass recall 0.9995 on dev, with the remaining actives on the window-first trial where prev_state is unknown. Magnitude: largest after a rare-rewarded a2 trial (a2 -> S1, rewarded): that case is 99% active and holds 57% of mass and 86% of the top activation quartile. That is the model-based switch-to-a1 signal. After a common a1 -> S1 reward it fires only about 40% of the time and weakly, mostly when the D1 policy logit (a1 - a2) is not already strongly a1 (choice < 3). With that condition, precision is 0.89 and mass recall 0.76 on dev. Without the choice condition, prev_state==1 alone gives F1 0.61 and mass recall 0.85. Never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1, or after reward in S2. All variables are observed at D1.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & last=a2 S1 r (+10.44), in_rew=1 (+5.16), stay=0 (+3.55), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+2.50), phase=D1 & this=a1 S1 (+2.06), phase=D1 & this=a1 S2 (+1.98). Lower it: in_rew=0 (-7.35), phase=D1 & last=a1 S2 r (-4.11), last=a1 S2 r (-4.10), action=2 (-3.99).
